name: Serialis refs (variant)
description: Variant page block: refs per location and state, gap with Shopify stock, button that opens the “Add refs” action.

common.offlineBody: Submitting is not possible until the network is back. What you typed is kept.

designation.suffix: Unit recognized by its last 4 characters: {{ref}}. Check that it is the right one.
designation.ambiguous: {{count}} units match: type the full ref.
designation.tooShort: Type at least 4 characters, or the full ref.
designation.unknown: None of the proposed units matches this ref.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Reload the Shopify admin page.
errors.forbidden: You do not have the rights for this action.
errors.not_found: Not found: it may have been deleted.
errors.validation_failed: The submitted data is not valid.
errors.idempotency_conflict: This request was already sent with different content. Reload and try again.
errors.precondition_failed: This unit was changed in the meantime. Reload to see the current values.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.unit_not_available: This unit is not available: it is already allocated to an order, on hold or locked.
errors.invalid_transition: This action is not possible in the current state of the unit or order (for example, already being prepared or shipped).
errors.variant_mismatch: This ref belongs to another variant.
errors.location_mismatch: This unit is not at the right location.
errors.ambiguous_ref: Several units match: type the full ref.
errors.not_tracked: This variant is not tracked by Serialis.
errors.emergency_stop: Emergency stop is on: actions are suspended. Lift it from the Serialis app.
errors.simulation_expired: The simulation has expired. Run it again.
errors.incompatible_settings: This action is incompatible with the current settings.
errors.network_error: Could not connect. Check your network and try again.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

detail.no_usable_deficit: No gap in Shopify at this location: choose “Received now” (Shopify stock +1 per ref).
detail.too_long_or_control_char: Ref too long or containing an invisible character. Re-read the label and type it again.
detail.empty: Ref empty after normalisation. Type the ref from the label.
detail.luhn: Invalid ref: the check digit (Luhn) does not match. Re-read the label.
detail.regex: Wrong ref format: it does not match the pattern set in the settings.
detail.invalid_regex: The ref pattern in the settings is invalid: fix it in Settings › Identifiers.
detail.unknown_or_untracked_variant: Unknown or untracked variant: activate its tracking in Tracked items, or fix the SKU.
detail.unknown_location: Unknown location: use the exact name of an active Shopify location.
detail.invalid_already_counted: Unreadable “already_counted” column: use yes or no (true/false, 1/0).
detail.duplicate_in_file: Ref duplicated in the file: keep a single row per ref.
detail.duplicate_in_list: Ref duplicated in the list: it is registered only once.
detail.beyond_gap: Beyond the gap with Shopify: choose “Received now” for the extra refs.
detail.admin_required: This action is reserved for Serialis administrators. Ask the shop owner to designate you.
detail.owner_required: Only the shop owner can designate or withdraw an administrator.
detail.owner_is_admin: The owner is always an administrator: this role cannot be withdrawn.
detail.last_admin: At least one administrator must remain.
detail.shop_frozen: The shop is frozen (subscription or uninstallation in progress): no write is possible for now.
detail.reconnect_required: Access to Shopify must be renewed: reopen the app from the Shopify admin to reconnect the shop.
detail.shop_not_installed: Serialis is not installed on this shop. Reopen the app from the Shopify admin.
detail.shop_mismatch: This request targets another shop than the one of your session. Reload the page.
detail.user_never_opened_the_app: This person has never opened Serialis: they must open it once before being designated.
detail.api_keys_interface_only: API keys are managed only from Settings › API in the app.
detail.api_key_revoked: This API key was revoked: create a new one in Settings › API.
detail.task_not_dead: This task is no longer stopped: the list was reloaded.
detail.write_not_dead: This write is no longer given up: the list was reloaded.
detail.fixed_in_mvp: This setting is fixed in this version and cannot be changed.
detail.scope_not_allowed: This setting can only be chosen at shop level.
detail.invalid_value: Value not allowed for this setting.

variantBlock.heading: Serialis refs
variantBlock.notTracked: This variant is not tracked by Serialis yet.
variantBlock.trackEffect: No write to Shopify stock. Existing stock is registered ref by ref (“already counted”); open orders are not changed.
variantBlock.untrackEffect: Units in stock become untracked with no write: Shopify stock does not change and the variant stays sellable. Not possible while units are allocated, in transit or awaiting a return.
variantBlock.truncated: Partial figures: only the first {{count}} refs are loaded.
variantBlock.noStock: No stock and no refs yet.
variantBlock.refsEmpty: No refs registered for this variant.
variantBlock.initializingHint: Initialization: register existing stock as “already counted”.
